aboutText: For nearly 50 years, Spalviero's Auto Electrical has been providing quality auto electrical products and services to drivers in Melbourne's west. Founded by John Spalviero in 1969 in Essendon and later relocating to Airport West, the business now sees John and his son Robert continuing the legacy. With Robert bringing over 30 years of automotive repair experience, they can assist with any auto electrical issue, ensuring your vehicle runs smoothly.
servicesText: At Spalviero's Auto Electrical, we specialise in a wide range of auto electrical services, from battery replacements to complex wiring diagnostics. Our experienced team uses the latest tools to diagnose and repair issues efficiently, keeping your vehicle safe and reliable on the road.

services.title: Battery Services
services.desc: We test, replace, and maintain all types of vehicle batteries to ensure reliable starts and performance.

services.title: Alternator Repairs
services.desc: Our experts diagnose and repair alternator issues to keep your vehicle's electrical system charging properly.

services.title: Starter Motor Fixes
services.desc: We handle starter motor problems, from repairs to replacements, for smooth engine ignition.

services.title: Lighting Systems
services.desc: From headlights to interior lights, we install, repair, and upgrade all vehicle lighting systems.

services.title: Wiring Diagnostics
services.desc: Advanced diagnostics to trace and fix electrical wiring faults, preventing potential hazards.

services.title: Air Conditioning Electrical
services.desc: We service the electrical components of your vehicle's air conditioning system for optimal climate control.
